note: What a server sends to mark the ground within circles, in place of the circles it marked before: each circle's flags apply to the ground within it. The header carries zero.

fields.name: count
fields.note: The count of circles that follow. A client reads no more than this many, and stops at the end of the message where fewer follow.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: A number naming this marking.

fields.name: circles
x
fields.note: The circle's centre, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: z
fields.note: The circle's centre, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: radius
fields.note: Its radius, in world units. A circle of radius 1000 or more marks nothing.

fields.name: flags
fields.note: The flags to add to each cell. Only the low 16 bits take effect.
The circles.

revisions.note: A client clears every circle it holds before marking these, and answers each with a message to the server under command 32 whose body is this sync id alone.
A client fails on the first of these in a match: it stops, marking no circle and sending no answer.
